title: Kenyan Crunchy Salad
description: A refreshing salad inspired by the flavors of Kenya, packed with crunchy vegetables and a hint of tanginess. Perfect for a light and satisfying meal.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, diced tomato, and chopped cilantro.
2. In a separate bowl, mix together the diced hard and chopped crunchy vegetables.
3. Add the mixed vegetable mixture to the bowl with the greens and toss to combine.
4. Drizzle with your favorite vegan dressing and serve immediately.
